title: Perfect matching in one-sided polynomial time
statement: The language of encodings of Boolean adjacency matrices whose associated bipartite graph has a perfect matching is decidable by a probabilistic Turing machine in polynomial time, accepting each member with probability at least $2/3$ and rejecting each nonmember on every computation branch.
